nary_nodes.label: Spider-Man: Brand New Day global opening
evidence: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' swung into the top spot at the box office and scored one of the highest-grossing opening weekends with an estimated haul of $355 million in the U.S. and Canada, far surpassing studio and analyst expectations.
The Sony Pictures film also brought in $572 million internationally for a worldwide total of $927 million, according to studio estimates.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Schema.org ScreeningEvent aligns with the examples of movie showings and box office performance.

nary_nodes.label: Spider-Man: Brand New Day ranks second
evidence: The movie’s haul now ranks as the second-biggest domestic and global opening ever, surpassed only by Walt Disney Co. and Marvel Studios’ 'Avengers: Endgame' in 2019.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event representing the ranking of a creative work in a specific context.

nary_nodes.label: Production of Spider-Man: Brand New Day
evidence: The film, which stars Tom Holland and Zendaya, is produced by Sony-owned Columbia Pictures, Marvel Studios and Pascal Pictures. Its production budget was about $225 million.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Schema.org PublicationEvent aligns with the example of movie production as a release event.

nary_nodes.label: Kevin Feige on Spider-Man's debut
evidence: Marvel Studios President and 'Spider-Man' producer Kevin Feige called the debut 'truly phenomenal.' 'We are grateful to audiences everywhere for coming out and experiencing our film the way it was meant to be seen,' he said in a statement Sunday. 'This debut reflects the enduring power of Marvel’s characters, and the connection they continue to have with fans around the world — and, as audiences saw, it sets up exciting things to come.'

nary_nodes.label: Tom Rothman on Spider-Man's theme
evidence: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' is fundamentally a movie about friendship, about the balm of connection in all our lives,' Sony Pictures Motion Picture Group Chairman Tom Rothman said in a statement Sunday. 'He added that this theme resonates with 'audiences of all ages and all around the world.'

nary_nodes.label: The Odyssey domestic performance
evidence: This time around, 'Spider-Man' was up against the juggernaut holdover Universal Pictures’ Christopher Nolan film, 'The Odyssey,' which came in second at the domestic box office with $51 million on its way to a global total of $911.4 million.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Schema.org ScreeningEvent aligns with the examples of movie showings and box office performance.

nary_nodes.label: Universal Pictures hits $4B mark
evidence: The strong performance of 'The Odyssey,' as well as the billion-dollar-grossing 'The Super Mario Galaxy Movie' and 'Michael' earlier this year, helped push Universal over the $4-billion global box office mark this weekend, the first studio to do so this year.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Schema.org SaleEvent aligns with the example of hitting a revenue milestone through sales.

nary_nodes.label: Toy Story 5 domestic performance
evidence: Walt Disney Co. and Pixar’s 'Toy Story 5' came in third with $6.3 million to add to its worldwide total of more than $1.06 billion.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Schema.org ScreeningEvent aligns with the examples of movie showings and box office performance.

evidence: Universal and Illumination’s 'Minions & Monsters' ($5.8 million) and Disney’s live-action 'Moana' ($5.3 million) rounded out the top five this weekend, according to data from Rentrak.
